findings.title: Shai-Hulud payload path .claude/execution.js
findings.description: StepSecurity lists .claude/execution.js as the payload copy committed into repositories. A file you created at this path also matches.

findings.title: Shai-Hulud payload path .claude/router_runtime.js
findings.description: Microsoft's Shai-Hulud 2.0 note lists .claude/router_runtime.js as a payload copy written next to the Claude SessionStart hook.

findings.title: Claude settings SessionStart hook runs node .vscode/setup.mjs
findings.description: The same StepSecurity writeup describes .claude/settings.json with a SessionStart hook whose command is node .vscode/setup.mjs.

findings.title: Shai-Hulud loader path setup.mjs under .claude or .vscode
findings.description: StepSecurity and Microsoft describe setup.mjs written to .claude and .vscode as the loader those IDE hooks execute.

findings.title: Persistence file from the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: The same notice lists ~/.config/.smt and ~/.config/.smtk on Linux and macOS, and %USERPROFILE%\.config\smt.cmd and smtk on Windows. File contents are not read or displayed.

findings.title: Persistence file from the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: The same notice lists ~/.config/.smt and ~/.config/.smtk on Linux and macOS, and %USERPROFILE%\.config\smt.cmd and smtk on Windows. File contents are not read or displayed.

findings.title: SSH authorized_keys matches the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: Cursor reported that marketplace copies of Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 appended an ssh-ed25519 key whose comment is svc-telemetry. The key material below is the public key from that notice.

findings.title: Shai-Hulud loader path setup.mjs under .claude or .vscode
findings.description: StepSecurity and Microsoft describe setup.mjs written to .claude and .vscode as the loader those IDE hooks execute.

findings.title: VS Code task runs node .claude/setup.mjs
findings.description: StepSecurity described a Shai-Hulud wave that commits .vscode/tasks.json with a folderOpen task whose command is node .claude/setup.mjs.

findings.title: Startup script sysmon.cmd from the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: The notice names the Windows fallback %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\sysmon.cmd.

findings.title: LaunchAgent com.apple.sysmond.plist from the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: The notice names ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.sysmond.plist (label com.apple.sysmond) as the macOS persistence plist.

findings.title: Scheduled task SysMon from the tampered Claude Code extension
findings.description: The notice names a scheduled task SysMon. This matches the task file at Windows\System32\Tasks\SysMon. A legitimate task with the same name would also match.

findings.title: Crontab command references .config/.smt
findings.description: The notice describes a Linux @reboot crontab entry that runs .config/.smt. The matched text is the published path fragment, not a copy of the script.

findings.title: Temp file name .stk_ plus 10 hex characters
findings.description: The notice names /tmp/.stk_<10 hex>, $TMPDIR/.stk_<10 hex>, and %TEMP%\.stk_<10 hex> as SSH identity files. Contents are not read.
findings.evidence: temp file name matched; contents not read

findings.title: core.hooksPath is set
findings.description: Git runs hooks from this directory on every repository command that uses hooks.

findings.title: download or decode piped to a shell
findings.description: Matched a shell startup line. Common toolchain PATH prefixes are not reported.

findings.title: SSH authorized key forces a command
